notes: The file the site's jurisdiction record names as its media export; results page https://results.sos.ga.gov/results/public/Georgia/elections/2022NovGen. The site marks the election's results official (its record, https://results.sos.ga.gov/results/public/api/elections/Georgia/2022NovGen: isOfficialResults true, last updated 2024-12-04). File created 2025-01-08.
gaps: The counties' own contests (county offices, county commissions, boards of education, soil and water supervisors, special elections, city contests and local questions)

The Secretary's results site now carries only the contests it reports statewide for this election, county by county; the earlier results site that held each county's page (results.enr.clarityelections.com) answers 403, and the counties' own canvasses were not read.
The Secretary's file for this election gives county figures only.
The Secretary's files print no write-in votes; the Clerk of the House prints the federal ones.
